title: Museum Evening Hours
transcript: Good evening, visitors. Just a reminder that the museum is open until nine tonight as part of our Thursday Late series. At seven, one of our curators will give a free twenty-minute talk on the new ancient textiles exhibit, starting by the entrance to Gallery Four. The café on the ground floor will close at eight, so if you'd like something to eat, now's a good time.

questions.stem: What will happen at seven o'clock?
options: The café will begin serving dinner
A curator will give a short talk
questions.explanation: A curator will give a free twenty-minute talk at seven.

questions.stem: Why does the speaker mention that the café closes at eight?
options: To explain why the museum closes early
To announce a new café menu
questions.explanation: The speaker says now is a good time to eat because the café closes at eight.
